checks.area: Durable intent, process lifecycle and unknown
checks.conclusion: Exclusive 0600/fsync+directory-sync journal precedes signals. Stopped must be confirmed using the existing nonce/group helper. Pending Web record and later identity are durably written. Unknown stop/spawn/persistence never automatically restarts or signals another role; previous pending/unknown blocks changed operation ID. Same-body replay only observes, with no repeat stop/spawn.

The replacement changes only Web process identity and webHost source metadata. Config, optional profile/maintenance and release-pointer bytes plus remaining state are checked unchanged. Existing bootstrap/publish/rollback defaults still use original marker/process/save paths; their six original PG cases were not rerun. No center/runner stop port is called by this flow.

checks.area: Bounded source identity and deployment limit
checks.conclusion: Eight bounded host files distinguish legacy versus selected backend artifact, with before/after digests. This is a byte record, not directory immutability or full lazy dependency proof. Real deployment needs its own fixed source/runtime and compatibility inputs; existing e5 sourceRepository=backend-release cannot be substituted for personal Flow.
